definitions.explanation: A professional who designs buildings and oversees their construction. Requires certification in Japan.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{建築家|けんちくか}に{家|いえ}を{設計|せっけい}してもらった。
examples.english: I had a famous architect design my house.

examples.japanese: {建築家|けんちくか}になるには{資格|しかく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: You need qualifications to become an architect.

examples.japanese: この{美術館|びじゅつかん}は{日本人|にほんじん}{建築家|けんちくか}の{作品|さくひん}だ。
examples.english: This museum is the work of a Japanese architect.

notes:
COMPOUND: {建築|けんちく} (architecture, construction) + {家|か} (professional, expert)

PROFESSIONAL TERMS:
・{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし} (first-class architect - highest license)
・{二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし} (second-class architect)
・{建築士|けんちくし} (registered architect - official title)

DISTINCTION: {建築家|けんちくか} is the general term often used for creative/artistic architects, while {建築士|けんちくし} is the official licensed professional title.

FAMOUS JAPANESE ARCHITECTS: {安藤忠雄|あんどうただお}, {隈研吾|くまけんご}, {磯崎新|いそざきあらた}
